description: France's capital is known for major museums, monuments, neighbourhood walks and cruises along the Seine.
Venice is the historic heart of a lagoon city built across small islands and connected by canals, including the Grand Canal.

description: Santorini is a volcanic island complex in the southern Cyclades, shaped by its caldera and known for settlements such as Oia and Fira.
Kyoto served as Japan's capital for more than a thousand years and preserves an extensive heritage of temples, shrines and traditional arts.
The Czech capital spans the Vltava River and brings together a millennium of architecture, monuments, museums and performing arts.
The Maldives is an Indian Ocean nation spanning the equator, formed by 1,192 islands grouped into a double chain of 26 atolls.
Hallstatt is a lakeside town within the Hallstatt-Dachstein/Salzkammergut cultural landscape, shaped by Alpine geography and salt mining documented since prehistoric times.
Bora Bora is a volcanic island in French Polynesia's Society Islands, surrounded by a lagoon and dominated by Mount Otemanu.
address: Bora Bora, Society Islands, French Polynesia

description: The Amalfi Coast is a cultural landscape on the southern Sorrentine Peninsula, where steep mountains, coastal towns and terraced cultivation meet the Tyrrhenian Sea.
Bruges preserves a medieval street plan, canal network and Gothic architecture reflecting its role as a major European commercial and cultural centre.
Old Québec is a fortified historic district founded in the early 17th century, preserving ramparts, gates and an upper and lower town.
Bali is an Indonesian island and province known for beaches, volcanic landscapes, rice terraces and living artistic and religious traditions.
Tuscany is a central Italian region combining Renaissance art cities, medieval towns, vineyard-covered countryside and a Tyrrhenian coastline.
Cappadocia is a volcanic landscape in central Türkiye known for the rock-cut sanctuaries of Göreme and settlements carved into soft stone.
Lake Como is a mountain-framed lake in Lombardy whose shores connect historic villas and towns including Como, Bellagio, Menaggio and Lecco.
Seychelles is an archipelago of 115 islands in the western Indian Ocean, including granitic inner islands and remote coralline outer islands.
Salzburg's historic centre preserves medieval-to-Baroque urban fabric and is closely associated with the music of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.
Dubrovnik's walled Old City on the Dalmatian coast preserves Gothic, Renaissance and Baroque churches, monasteries, palaces and fountains.
Reykjavík is Iceland's capital, where the Atlantic coast, nearby mountains, geothermal landscapes and opportunities to observe the northern lights meet an active cultural scene.
Charleston is a historic port city on the South Carolina coast, known for its preserved streetscapes, architecture, waterfront and Lowcountry cultural heritage.
Disneyland Park is the original Disney theme park in Anaheim, with attractions and entertainment arranged across themed lands.
Universal Studios Hollywood combines a working film studio tour with rides, shows and themed entertainment in Universal City.
Tokyo Disneyland is a Disney theme park at Tokyo Disney Resort, with attractions, parades and entertainment distributed across seven themed areas.
Europa-Park is a theme park in Rust whose themed areas interpret European countries alongside fantasy areas, rides and live shows.
Ferrari World Abu Dhabi is an indoor theme park on Yas Island built around Ferrari-inspired thrill rides, family attractions and exhibitions.
address: Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

description: LEGOLAND Billund is the original LEGOLAND park, featuring LEGO-themed rides and Miniland models near the town where the LEGO Group was founded.
Everland is a theme park resort in Yongin with thrill rides, family attractions, seasonal gardens and animal-focused areas.
Ocean Park Hong Kong combines amusement rides, marine and wildlife exhibits, education and conservation programmes on the southern side of Hong Kong Island.
Tivoli Gardens is a historic amusement garden in central Copenhagen with rides, landscaped grounds, performance venues and seasonal events.
Six Flags Magic Mountain is a theme park in Valencia, California, centred on roller coasters alongside family rides and live entertainment.
Chimelong Paradise is a large amusement park in Guangzhou's Panyu District with roller coasters, family rides and themed entertainment.
Lotte World in Seoul combines the indoor Lotte World Adventure park with outdoor attractions on Magic Island beside Seokchon Lake.
PortAventura World is a resort near Salou and Vila-seca with themed parks, rides, shows and on-site accommodation.
IMG Worlds of Adventure is an indoor theme park in Dubai with themed entertainment zones, rides and family attractions.
address: City of Arabia, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

description: Alton Towers Resort is a theme park in Staffordshire with roller coasters, family attractions, landscaped gardens and resort accommodation.
Efteling is a fantasy-themed park in Kaatsheuvel built around fairy tales, storytelling attractions, dark rides and roller coasters.
Gardaland Resort is an amusement destination near Lake Garda with thrill rides, family attractions and themed entertainment.
Hong Kong Disneyland is a Disney resort on Lantau Island with themed lands, attractions, parades and stage entertainment.
Dreamworld is a theme park at Coomera on Queensland's Gold Coast, combining thrill and family rides with wildlife experiences.
Parque Warner Madrid is a cinema-themed amusement park near Madrid with roller coasters, family attractions, character areas and live shows.
address: San Martín de la Vega, Madrid, Spain
